5078-5642-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
5078-5642-7010.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2724-4243-8172.description:
Actiate Venser by putting two loyalty counters on him, exiling and returning (at end step) Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

728-1420-2178.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
728-1420-2178.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat.

4871-5113-5220-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5113-5220-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5113-5220-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-3967-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-3967-6752.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1836-4019-4221--85.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that can add {U} and that shares a name with at least two other lands you control.
1836-4019-4221--85.description:
Play the land.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, adding at least two additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
1836-4019-4221--85.notes: You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

618-4456-7356-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {1}{R} due to Longshot.
Longshot and Hematite Talisman trigger,.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

457-698-1792-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-698-1792-4404.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Retraction Helix by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Will.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Retraction Helix.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Retraction Helix by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4478-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
4478-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
4478-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Tetzin, Gnome Champion // The Golden-Gear Colossus

1115-2388-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2388-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Golden-Gear Colossus as attackers.
The Golden-Gear Colossus triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-2438-2843.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1334-1980-2034-3029.description:
Cast Seasonal Ritual either from your hand or from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {G}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Seasonal Ritual.
Resolve both Seasonal Rituals, adding {G}{G} and then exiling the original Seasonal ritual with the ability to cast it from exile later.
Cast Rosethorn Acolyte from exile by paying {2}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rosethorn Acolyte.
Repeat.

1402-3593-4359-4779.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Diamond Lion from your hand onto the battlefield.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Garna from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Garna enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Diamond Lion by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Garna.
Resolve the Garna ability from step 3, returning all creature cards that were put in your graveyard this turn to your hand.
Repeat.

465-2150-5147.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from exile to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Hero of the Dunes.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1251-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2511-4053-4336-6989.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4053-6798-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

856-1379-1477-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1494-5435-6822-6838.description:
If you have more than three cards in hand, activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have three or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, Doctor Octopus triggers, causing you to draw at least five cards.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2034-4210-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Pious Evangel triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Wayward Disciple triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
2034-4210-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

539-2034-5649-6517.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a 4/4 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3741-4740-6613--44.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4 if you've cast two or more spells this turn, 5 if you've cast one spell this turn, or 7 otherwise.
3741-4740-6613--44.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying {0} and 3 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir and Void Mirror trigger.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Resolve the Void Mirror trigger, countering the artifact spell and returning it to your graveyard.
Repeat

4089-6598.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Glasspool Mimic's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of General Leo Cristophe.
Repeat from step 2.

215-5921-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1329-1477-2178-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1477-2178-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

276-331-791-3693.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
276-331-791-3693.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1684-2178-4871-5147.notablePrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
1684-2178-4871-5147.description:
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Rakka Mar trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1283-2011-3598.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One has a power of five or greater.
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1283-2011-3598.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Rapacious One.
Rapacious One triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate five Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If Rapacious One has power six or greater and/or a Warrior you control can attack, this combo nets infinite creature tokens.

3107-4222-4735.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Vazi.
You have created at least two Treasure tokens this turn.
3107-4222-4735.description:
Cast Crafty Cutpurse by paying {3}{U}.
Crafty Cutpurse enters the battlefield, causing all tokens that would be created under an opponent's control this turn to be created under your control instead.
Activate Vazi by tapping it, creating at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Vazi.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1765-4050-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk' second ability by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-2955.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Justiciar's Portal.
141-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Justiciar's Portal, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Justiciar's Portal, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-4871-4917-5200.easyPrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Jan Jansen.
2034-4871-4917-5200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional noncreature artifact.
2034-4871-4917-5200.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other noncreature artifact, creating two 1/1 Construct creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Construct tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Constructs die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat.
2034-4871-4917-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

765-1479-4488.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-4488.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Rampaging Baloths, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
